reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Cavalry and Combat Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to our battle system in Provincia! Say goodbye to the old HP bar system and hello to a more immersive experience with bronze unit cards, detailed unit busts, and dynamic cavalry movements. Our new raid AI will also change the way you approach battles, making them more strategic and engaging. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cavalry-cards-and-raid-lines?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cavalry-cards-and-raid-lines
